site.name: Lemonmath
site.headline: Learn math, one clear step at a time.
site.tagline: Short, friendly lessons with worked examples and practice, written in plain English.
site.description: Free math lessons in plain English: clear explanations, worked examples and practice problems with full solutions.

chapters.title: Quadratic Functions
chapters.summary: Graphs, vertices and the discriminant: everything you need to understand parabolas and solve quadratic equations.

lessons.title: The quadratic function and its graph
lessons.description: Learn what a quadratic function is, how its parabola opens, and how to find the vertex and axis of symmetry, with worked examples.

lessons.title: Quadratic equations and the discriminant
lessons.description: Solve any quadratic equation with the discriminant and the quadratic formula, see why it works, and use Vieta's formulas.

chapters.title: Solving Triangles
chapters.summary: Use the law of cosines and the law of sines to find missing sides, angles and areas.

lessons.title: The law of cosines
lessons.description: Use the law of cosines to find a missing side or angle in any triangle. Clear notation, worked examples and practice with solutions.

lessons.title: The law of sines and the area of a triangle
lessons.description: Use the law of sines to find sides and the circumradius of a triangle, and learn the area formula with sine. Worked examples and practice.
